subject: POC rebaseline: added use cases & updated success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@acmecorp.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap + next steps (POC scope + success criteria)

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great conversation. As promised, quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on scope and success criteria for the POC.

Summary of what we demonstrated:
- Redwood hosted inference for chat & batch embedding flows
- Observability (latency/cost per route) and canary rollouts
- Private deployment options for dedicated capacity

Proposed POC scope (as discussed):
1) Real-time customer support assistant (primary): integrate chat API into support UI, 95th percentile latency < 350ms for 1 concurrent operator.
2) Embeddings-based search (secondary): daily batch embedding of new KB articles and similarity search within 2s for top 5 results.

Success criteria (initial):
- Chat replies within SLA on sample traffic (95th% < 350ms)
- Quality: average helpfulness rating >= 4/5 on a 100-item prompt set
- Embeddings: recall@5 >= 0.78 on provided eval set
Owners: Marissa (commercial), Rishi (SE lead), Monica (CS lead), Acme: Priya (product), Derek (engineering)

Next steps:
- Rishi: network checklist + infra pre-check (by 02/18)
- Monica: onboarding plan and eval dataset template (by 02/19)
- Acme: confirm eval owners + data access (by 02/20)
I attached the success criteria doc and the network checklist. If this looks right, I'll send the updated SOW and timeline to get the POC started next week.
Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (POC scope + success criteria)

Thanks Marissa — great writeup. A couple of things popped up on our side after internal alignment:
1) We'd like to add an automated ticket summarization use case to the POC (extractive summary + suggested tags). This will be higher priority than embeddings search if feasible.
2) We want to adjust the quality metric: instead of a single "helpfulness" rating, can we include two measures — factual accuracy on answers (automated spot-check) and end-user satisfaction (survey)?

Impact / asks:
- Likely needs an extra eval set (50 ticket examples) and a small deduped KB snapshot for context testing.
- Can you confirm if the 95th percentile latency target still holds with the summarization prompt (longer context)?
- Will this change the timeline? We had targeted kickoff 02/22.
Derek and I are available to jump on a 30-min sync tomorrow if useful.
Thanks,
Priya
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@acmecorp.com>, Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (POC scope + success criteria)

Priya — thanks for the quick feedback, and glad to see the additional use case. Short answers below and proposed path to rebaseline: 

Feasibility: Rishi/Vivek — can you confirm feasibility for adding ticket summarization and whether that materially affects the latency target? My read: summarization with longer context may increase per-request latency; we can mitigate with smaller context windows, streaming responses, and prefix caching. Will confirm once Rishi does an initial perf estimate.

Quality metrics: happy to move to dual metrics. Proposal:
- Factual accuracy: automated spot-check (precision on entity extraction / factual answers) target >= 0.85
- End-user satisfaction: mean survey >= 4/5 on 100 sampled replies

Timeline / kickoff: If technical checks finish by 02/18 and Acme provides eval data by 02/20, we can still aim for a soft kickoff on 02/22, but we should plan a two-week rebaseline window after initial data ingestion to validate metrics (so primary POC window extends by ~2 weeks).

Action: I'll prepare a rebaseline doc and updated SOW to reflect the added summarization use case, updated success criteria, an updated timeline (+2 weeks buffer), and ownership. Expect that from me by EOD 02/18.

Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivev.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (POC scope + success criteria)

Quick tech note after a short spike:
- Summarization (50-ticket eval) looks feasible on our existing hosted cluster under the planned concurrency, but 95th% latency for full-context summaries is likely to be ~600-700ms unless we tune the prompt/context window.
- Mitigations: prefix caching for KB context, streaming output to perceived lower latency, or using a quantized faster variant for the summarization route. Cost impact: ~+12% token compute if we keep full context.
Recommendation:
1) Keep the 95th% <350ms target for the chat flow (customer-facing chat) as-is.
2) Define a separate SLO for summarization: 95th% <700ms for full-context summaries, with a goal of <500ms after tuning.
3) Add a short perf check in the first week of the POC to decide on faster variant / quantization if needed.
I'll attach a short perf estimate and proposed routing policy.
- Rishi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: POC rebaseline doc (v3) + ask list

Priya / Derek — attaching the rebaseline doc (ACME_POC_success_criteria_v3.docx) and the network checklist. Highlights from the doc:
- Added use case: Ticket summarization (50 sample tickets + 200 KB articles)
- Updated success criteria: dual metrics (factual accuracy >=0.85, survey mean >=4/5); chat 95th% <350ms; summarization 95th% <700ms (goal <500ms).
- Timeline: Kickoff 02/22; data ingestion 02/22-02/26; perf/quality tuning 02/29-03/05; final validation week 03/08-03/12. Total POC window extended by 2 weeks.
- Ownership: Marissa (commercial), Monica (CS), Rishi (SE), Acme: Priya (product), Derek (eng).

Asks for Acme:
- Send 50 ticket examples + KB snapshot before EOD 02/20
- Provide access to a staging support UI (or a replay dataset) for end-to-end latency tests
- Legal: if there are any redlines to the SOW, please route to legal@acmecorp.com (looped)

If everyone agrees, I'll send an updated SOW and schedule the kickoff.
Thanks,
Marissa
